generator: numpy.default_rng.PCG64; independent SeedSequence children for design, beta, noise and censoring
onsets: 48 events per run; first at 12s; successive intervals Uniform(4,8)s; independently permuted balanced condition labels
hrf: sampled unit-peak GAM shape t^5 exp(-t)/Gamma(6), duration 32s, 0.1s grid; linear interpolation to acquisition times; identical generating and fitting HRF
nuisance: run-specific Legendre orders 0..3 on full run; true nuisance coefficients zero in core
beta: 24 fixed condition means Normal(1,0.5^2); independent trial deviations Normal(0,0.5^2); preserve truth within paired method comparisons
noise_generation: exact stationary Gaussian run covariance Cholesky; no samplewise variance renormalization
censoring_core: 10 percent uniform without replacement per run
two uniformly located nonoverlapping 12-TR gaps per run
tuning: existing fold-local repeated-condition beta MSE on tuning runs only; minimum loss, largest fraction (weakest shrinkage) on exact ties; fraction frozen for evaluation runs
covariance_estimation: inner folds estimate on training runs only; final estimates pool all four tuning runs with independent run blocks; full-trial and compact condition-plus-drift pilot designs; one pair shared across runs; freeze for evaluation
external_reference: pin AFNI revision; record actual REML grid, sign restrictions and CORcut; do not claim it matches native grid unless verified
oracle: true covariance only for representable truth; oracle penalty selection separately labeled, never primary
precision_target: paired beta-MSE difference MCSE <= 0.01 in squared-beta units for all prespecified primary method contrasts; otherwise report unmet target at cap
primary_contrasts: ridge minus unpenalized within fitted family
preserve minus reset within estimator and family
metrics: bias squared and variance conditional on fixed design and beta truth across noise replicates
failure_policy: explicit error/status, no silent white fallback; paired summaries disclose missing pairs; publish failures by cell
replicate_policy: draw design, beta truth and censor mask once per scenario; vary only noise seed across conditional Monte Carlo replicates; additional truth/design seeds reported separately; draw innovations replicate-major then transpose so increasing replicate count preserves the prefix
revision_note: 2026-11-08, before full study: v2 corrected ties to largest fraction; v3 fixes replicate-major noise draws so cumulative precision batches preserve earlier realizations. v4 explicitly selects the lower Cholesky triangle for noise multiplication after generator variance checks exposed unused-triangle contamination in the local SciPy stack; earlier pilot noise scenarios are superseded.
